frames.caption: Take a long stance, one foot forward and one back, dumbbells at your sides.
Lower straight down between the feet while the stance stays planted.
Rear knee hovers just off the floor; front foot stays planted.
Drive through the front foot and glute to ascend smoothly.
Reset tall at the top before beginning the next repetition.

entries.summary: Five drawn positions of a dumbbell split squat, seen from the side.

entries.name: Barbell Side Split Squat
entries.reason: Source-bound front-view draft. Standing tall with the bar across the back of the shoulders and the feet planted wide; the hips travel down and toward the lead foot as the lead knee and hip bend, the lead knee coming forward over its foot, while the trailing leg stays long with only a slight bend, and the lead leg straightens to return. Both feet stay where they are. One side is shown; the last caption carries the change of sides. Not drawn: the lead foot angled out, which this front-view foot cannot show; the caption states it.
entries.summary: Feet wide and the bar across the back of the shoulders, bend the lead knee and hip to lower toward that side with the trailing leg long, then extend the lead leg to return.

frames.caption: Stand tall with a barbell across the back of the shoulders and the feet placed wide apart, the lead foot angled out to the side.
Bend the knee and hip of the lead leg to lower toward that side, keeping the trailing leg only slightly bent.
Shift toward the working side. Keep the trailing leg long.
Return by extending the hip and knee of the lead leg.
Complete the reps on one side, then work the other.
